Empty repo basically. Need to build a complete playable game: "game RGB anime Jujutsu gojo and infinity spishel effect". Likely "RGB anime Jujutsu Gojo and Infinite Spiral effect" — a Jujutsu Kaisen-inspired game with Gojo Satoru, RGB neon aesthetic, Infinity (Limitless) shield, and spiral effect. Must be careful with IP: we can make an original fan-inspired game with a white-haired sorcerer character, "Limitless/Infinity" barrier, "Hollow Purple" style orb, RGB neon. Avoid direct copyrighted assets; names? The user explicitly asks for Jujutsu Gojo and infinity spiral effect. We can include names as fan-style but should probably make an original homage: "SATORU" or "GOJO"? Since this is a game, using characters is risky but allowed? Policy doesn't prohibit fan art. We can build original visuals (canvas) and use the term "Infinity" (mechanic). I'll name the game "LIMITLESS: RGB SPIRAL" with a white-haired sorcerer "Gojo-inspired". Maybe title "INFINITY // RGB" and character "SATORU". Keep it fan-game.

Design plan:
- Single-page canvas game, no build dependencies, runs via static server. Files: index.html, style.css, game.js maybe modules.
- Visual: neon RGB anime look, black/deep purple background, grid horizon, glowing particles, spiral/vortex shader-like effect rendered procedurally in canvas 2D (or WebGL? Canvas 2D can do fancy).
- Gameplay: arena survival/bullet-hell: player sorcerer moves with WASD/arrow keys or touch joystick; enemies (cursed spirits) spawn and fire cursed projectiles. Player has "Infinity" shield that slows/freezes incoming projectiles within a radius (Limitless) — hold Space / shield button; also "Blue" pull and "Red" repel? Use RGB themed abilities:
  - Cyan/Blue (LMB or J / hold): "Blue" attraction vortex pulling enemies/projectiles, consumes energy.
  - Red (K): "Red" shockwave repel/damage.
  - Purple (Space or R?): "Hollow Purple" ultimate — combine blue+red, giant beam, clears screen, requires charge meter.
  - "Infinity" passive shield: incoming projectiles slow to a stop near you (drains focus meter).
- RGB color cycle for aesthetics, health bar, combo, score, waves.
- Infinity spiral effect: swirling spiral distortion around player, particles spiraling infinitely; use it as shield visual.
- Bosses every 5 waves maybe. Keep scope manageable but complete.

Let's aim for a polished single canvas game ~1200 lines JS. Title screen with animated RGB spiral, instructions, start. HUD, pause, game over, wave progression, screen shake, hit flash, particles, sound via WebAudio synth (no assets).

Controls:
- WASD / arrows move, touch virtual stick.
- Hold Shift or Space: Infinity (slows bullets within field, consumes "Cursed Energy").
- J / left click: Blue (vortex that pulls and damages enemies in radius, cost).
- K / right click: Red (repulsion burst damage, cost).
- L or Q: Hollow Purple when charge full (or hold J+K?). Make dedicated.
- On mobile: joystick + three buttons.

Maybe simpler: 2 abilities plus ultimate:
- "Blue" (hold) pulls projectiles/enemies toward cursor/player and charges ultimate.
- "Red" (tap) blast.
- Ultimate "PURPLE" fires a beam.

Infinity passive: projectiles within radius have speed reduced to near-zero and orbit player; that's both shield and visual spiral. But then game too easy—tie to energy. Let Infinity default ON while energy > 0? "Infinity" is always on but drains energy, recharges by killing. Enemies can melee. Cursed spirits touching you damage through Infinity (Infinity blocks projectiles only). Good balance: bullets slow within radius, melee enemies still hurt.

Bullet-hell with grazing and absorbing bullets. Enemy variety:
1. Drifter: homing blob, melee.
2. Caster: shoots orbs.
3. Spiral: shoots spiraling bullet patterns.
4. Boss: big, radial bursts, phase.

Score/combos, waves increasing.

Rendering: procedural neon brush. Use shadowBlur sparingly (performance). Use offscreen canvas for glow? We can draw with additive blending 'lighter' and gradients. Mobile performance concerns. Cap DPR at 2 (or 1.5 mobile).

RGB anime aesthetic: chromatic aberration via drawing RGB-shifted copies? We can do screen-level subtle RGB split. Simplest: overlay scanlines and vignette with CSS, plus particle colors cycling hue. Title uses big Japanese katakana? Text "無限" (infinity) and "呪術" maybe. Original look.

I should use custom font? Avoid network fonts (offline). Use system fonts + CSS letter spacing. Could embed via Google fonts but network may not be available in screenshot; better system stack with 'Impact'/'Arial Black' and monospace. Maybe use a Google Fonts import but fallback. No external assets.

Audio: WebAudio synthesized ambient drone + SFX. Start on user gesture.

Structure:
- index.html: canvas, UI overlays (title, pause, game over), HUD, mobile controls.
- style.css
- game.js (maybe split into modules? Single file easier; but ~1500 lines okay). Use ES module? No build. Single script.

Need testing with playwright-cli. Let's check available commands and server setup. Use tmux session with python http.server on port 3002 as per Agents.md. Check playwright-cli.

Let me plan gameplay details deeply.

Canvas internal resolution = CSS size * dpr, capped.

Game loop with dt clamp.

World: arena finite? Player constrained to screen bounds with margin. Camera static (arena = viewport). Enemies spawn from edges. Suitable for mobile.

Player:
- pos, vel, radius 16, hp 100, energy 100, ultimate charge 0..100, invuln timer, dash? Movement smooth acceleration, friction. Maybe dash (Shift) with i-frames; Infinity is automatic passive. Shift = "Infinity Step" dash? Keep controls simple:
  - Move WASD/arrows/joystick.
  - Infinity is always active (passive aura) but has a radius; bullets within radius slow down drastically and spiral; no energy cost but a "domain meter"? Hmm.
  - Blue: hold J/left mouse — continuous beam/vortex at cursor? Circle centered on player dragging projectiles. Costs energy/sec. Enemies pulled.
  - Red: K/right mouse — explosion at player, knocks back enemies & destroys bullets, cost 25.
  - Purple: L / Space — if charge >=100, fires giant beam at cursor / forward, huge damage, clears bullets. Charge builds by absorbing bullets with Infinity and kills.
  - Infinity: passive—projectiles that enter your 120px aura are slowed to 18% and orbit, then either absorbed (if slow) or pass? "Infinity" in lore: infinite series, attacks never reach. We can absorb bullets that stay within aura for 0.8s -> energy + charge. But if too many bullets, aura overloads? Not needed. Melee enemies shoot? Enemies colliding damage.
  - Maybe hold Space to "Expand Infinity" (aura radius x1.8, drains energy) for active defense. But passive already. Let's just have passive Infinity with visible spinning spiral and slow; energy used only for Blue/Red.

- Dash: Shift, short invuln dash with RGB trail, cooldown 1.2 s. Mobile gets dash button. Good.

Controls displayed: Move, Blue (J/left), Red (K/right), Purple (Space), Dash (Shift).

But right click conflicts with context menu; prevent. Left click also starts game. Using mouse for abilities may be awkward; keyboard enough. On mobile, three buttons + dash.

Aiming: abilities are radial/around player; Purple fires toward nearest enemy or aim direction (movement direction / mouse). Simpler: Purple creates a huge expanding ring/beam that damages all on screen? "Hollow Purple" as a screen-clearing spiral blast: time slows, giant purple orb expands from player, deals massive damage in a wide cone? For gameplay, screen-wide purple shockwave with beam toward aim. Let's make Purple: charge beam forward in aim direction (toward mouse if available, else last move dir), big length 1200, width 160, damages everything for 2s, with spiral visuals. On mobile auto-aim nearest enemy.

Blue: hold to create attraction field radius 220 around player that pulls enemies and bullets inward, damages enemies slowly, builds overcharge. Visual: blue vortex arcs. Costs energy 22/s.
Red: burst radius 260, knockback + damage 40, destroys bullets, cost 30, cooldown 2s.
Purple: charge requires 100 (absorbing bullets/energy or kills). Auto ready. Fires 1.1s beam in aim direction, damage 220 to boss, kills minions. Also full-screen flash + RGB split.

Energy regen 12/s, Blue drains 26/s, Red costs 28. Kills restore 6 energy. Bullet absorbed by Infinity +2 energy +1.2 charge. Kills +4 charge. Charge only from combat.

Enemies:
- Grunt "Blob": moves toward player, hp 30, r 18, melee contact 12 dmg, speed 60. RGB hue.
- Shooter "Eye": keeps distance ~260, fires aimed orb every 1.6s, hp 24.
- Spinner "Spiral": fires 3-5 bullets in spiral pattern, hp 40, slow.
- Charger "Claw": telegraph then dash at player, hp 50.
- Boss every 5 waves: "Cursed Womb" large spiral entity, hp 600+wave*80, attacks: radial ring, aimed triple, spiral spray, summons. Melee contact.
Maybe also "Shield" enemy? Enough.

Bullets: radius 6-9, speed 150-260, color hue random / red for enemy. Infinity slow within 150 px (or 120 + pulse). If bullet stays within aura for >0.9s, absorbed with nice effect. This means slow bullets stop and orbit; user can walk away and they resume? Better: inside aura, speed reduced to 12% and direction deflected into orbit; after absorb timer, disappear. Some bullets "heavy" resistant (boss purple) slow only 50%, to keep danger. Bullets can be destroyed by Red and Purple.

Spawning: waves with duration; spawn budget. Wave N spawns sets of enemies every interval, max alive cap. Boss on multiple of 5, with banner. After boss death, wave advances.

Score: kills * points * combo multiplier. Combo increases with kills, decays after 3s no kill. Graze? Bullets near miss +1? Keep.

Player HP: 100, contact damage with i-frames 1s. Health pickups? Every 3 waves drop heal orb? Add "cursed energy orbs" dropped by enemies that fly to player for charge/energy. Could simplify: kills drop small motes that auto-home and add energy/charge. Nice.

Difficulty scaling wave.

Visuals:
- Background: deep near-black with subtle RGB gradient, animated grid perspective lines? A rotating "domain" mandala of concentric circles + spiral arms behind player, quietly. Neon particles drifting. Screen-space scanlines/vignette via CSS overlay.
- Infinity aura: multiple rotating arcs, a logarithmic spiral drawn with 3 color passes (cyan, magenta, lime?) — RGB theme. "RGB anime" likely means colorful chromatic look. Use cyberpunk RGB palette (cyan #00f0ff, magenta #ff2bd6, lime/red?).
- Player: draw stylized white-haired figure top-down? Top-down anime sorcerer: white spiky hair circle, dark uniform, cyan visor/eyes. Small but readable. Add trailing afterimages. Maybe side view? Top-down with hair and blindfold (black band). Draw body ellipse, hair spikes triangles, blue glow eyes/band. Facing aim/velocity. Good.
- Enemies: cursed spirits as ink-blob shapes with eyes and teeth, neon rim; generated with wobble noise. Each type distinct color and silhouette.
- Bullets: glowing orbs with trails, colored; RGB cycle.
- Particles: additive circles, sparks, shockwave rings, floating Japanese glyphs? Add kanji "無限" as translucent particles in aura. Maybe use characters: 無限 (infinity), 蒼 (blue), 赫 (red), 紫 (purple). Nice anime.
- Hit effects: freeze frame, shake, RGB split overlay, chromatic aberration on big hits. Implement chromatic aberration by drawing scene offscreen and compositing red/blue shifted? Could be expensive but doable only on pulses. Simpler: CSS duplicate? Use ctx.globalCompositeOperation and draw a translucent offset copy of frame via offscreen canvas — full-screen copy per frame costly. Only on big hit, draw rotated/scaled translucent colored copies of flash rectangle. Good enough.
- Slow-mo on Purple activation (time scale 0.35 for 0.4s).
- Screen shake.

UI: top-left player HP bar + energy bar, top-center wave and score, bottom-right ability icons with cooldown/charge rings. Title screen overlays with animated gradient text and press start. HUD can be DOM for crispness. Draw ability cooldown rings in DOM via conic-gradient updating. Simpler DOM.

Title screen: full overlay with large "無限" watermark, "LIMITLESS // RGB" title with gradient, subtitle "SATORU GOJO FAN ARENA", start button, controls grid. Animated background canvas shows rotating spiral + particles (game loop running in "attract" mode).

Game over overlay with score, wave, time, best (localStorage), retry.
Pause with Esc/P, overlay resume.
Mobile controls: left joystick zone bottom-left, buttons bottom-right for Blue (hold), Red, Purple, Dash. Ability buttons always visible on touch devices (CSS @media pointer: coarse or JS detects). Ensure safe-area.

Need to prevent scrolling/zoom gestures: touch-action none, viewport-fit=cover, user-scalable=no.

Audio: synth ambient pad using oscillators; SFX functions: shoot, hit, explosion, absorb, ultimate, pickup, hurt, wave. Toggle mute button. Start audio on first gesture. Keep volumes low.

Testing: run static server on 3002 via tmux, use playwright-cli screenshot. Need to check playwright-cli availability and launch config. Let's inspect environment.

File structure:
/index.html
/style.css
/src/*.js? Single game.js maybe 2000 lines. Could split into modules for maintainability: js/main.js, js/game.js, js/entities.js, js/audio.js, js/render.js, js/input.js. Using ES modules requires server; fine. But single file easier for consistency and no import issues. I'll split modestly:
- js/main.js — boot, loop, state machine, input
- js/audio.js
- maybe all game in main.js is okay.

I'll write a well-organized single game.js (~1600 lines) and index/style.

Let's check tools and server.
